body.x: The ever-increasing development of IT machines is adding a technological luster to our everyday existence, but we are paying with our privacy. For now freely available to purchase in miniaturized forms that may take on the appearance of something as innocuous as a pen are devices capable of recording unawares all our personal conversations.
(Photo: SPEECH PROTECTION SYSTEM of Korea Communications Security (KCS)

As a result, intimate and revealing exchanges have been tapped and made public, from everyday conversations between individuals to business and government discussions, the contents of which were intended to remain behind closed doors. There have sometimes been grave consequences. Now attracting wide attention are technologies developed to intercept and resolve this problem at its source.

Korea Communications Security (KCS) is a supplier of anti-wire tapping solutions. KCS received notable thanks from the head of the Korean police service for the use of its technology in contributing to the secure and successful staging of the G20 Seoul summit in 2010. KCS has since been the recipient of an award at this year’s Canadian Technical Security Conference.

On display at KES 2012 is KCS's Speech Protection System, which is able to disable the tapping process at its source in any conference room. The system introduces the world's first acoustic noise falsifier circuit, capable of distorting and altering the contents of any conversation, and so bamboozling the listener with distorted sound and neutralizing the attempted wiretap before damage can be done.

The system is able to interrupt a wide variety of methods of eavesdropping including wired, wireless, laser, and device recording. And even if someone is in the same area, if they do not use the special provided earphone, despite the obvious fact that the individual is speaking, the contents of that individual’s conversation cannot be known. A wide application of use is possible for KCS's Speech Protection System, in big business, corporate security, national security and any other scenario in which privacy is paramount.
